_comment: The ONE home for the words this project replaces with a plain standard term, read by both of its readers: guardrails/check-vocabulary.py (over a whole document named on the command line) and scripts/spec-style-lint.py (line by line, as its machine-jargon arm). The two kept separate lists until 2026-07-28, so a word added to one was invisible to the other; they are merged here. Each key is a coined, minted, or machine word the method has retired; its value is the plain standard term to use instead. It must never contain a word the clean corpus legitimately uses. docs/language-rules.md prints this map inside r02, read out of this file at build time, so the page and both checkers can never disagree.
